title: My New House Has One Rule: Never Turn Off The Hallway Light
cta: Tag a friend who sleeps with the lights on
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. Would you have broken the rule? Tell us in the comments.
lines: My new house has one rule.
Never turn off the hallway light.
The old owner wrote it on the switch. In red.
Dad laughed. He said it wastes power.
Last night, I switched it off.
There were doors I had never seen.
One door was open. It was my room.
The me in bed sat up and smiled.
